tips.title: Ama aliko ngu!
body: **Ama aliko ngu!** (let’s celebrate!), **Awa’difo emuzu ni** (thanks for coming), **Etu ti ni muke!** (happy birthday!).
**Ota** is the wedding: **ota oku** the bride, **ota agupi** the groom.

tips.title: Afa fezu
body: **Afa fezu** (a thing given) is a gift: **Ma ji afa fezu emu ra** (I have brought a gift).

culture.title: Bride wealth
body: A Lugbara marriage involves visits between the two families and the giving of bride wealth, traditionally cattle.
